name: SmartLink Chatbox
author: fxgadgets

sections.description:
SmartLink Chatbox is a lightweight and responsive WordPress plugin that allows you to display floating buttons for WhatsApp, Telegram, Phone Call, and a custom link. Site admins can fully control the button text, image, background color, text color, and the order of image and text. The buttons are highly customizable via the admin panel.

Key Features

  • Floating buttons for WhatsApp, Telegram, Phone Call, and a Custom URL.
  • Fully customizable styles including colors, text, and images.
  • Set button position (left, right, center).
  • Choose content order: image-text or text-image.
  • Built-in default images for all buttons (stored in plugin folder).
  • Reset to Defaults button in the settings panel.
  • Responsive design optimized for mobile and desktop.
  • Clean, minimal, and fast-loading.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SmartLink Chatbox to configure the buttons.
sections.faq:
How can I change the text or image of each button?

Go to SmartLink Chatbox settings, where you can customize the text, image URL, and link for each button. If no image is provided, the plugin uses built-in default images.

Can I reorder the text and image?

Yes. Use the Content Order setting to choose between image-text or text-image.

How do I reset all settings to default?

Click the Reset to Defaults button on the settings page. This removes saved settings and loads the original defaults.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. It is a lightweight plugin with no external dependencies.

2.0

  • Added: Strict validation for WhatsApp and Telegram buttons — buttons appear only if both URL and image are provided.
  • Improved: Better image and text ordering logic.
  • Fixed: Bug causing buttons to display without images.
  • Cleaned code structure for better readability and future expansion.

1.0

  • Initial release.
  • WhatsApp, Telegram, and custom link support.
  • Positioning and content order options.
  • Admin settings page with live configuration.
